text:
Alex: Quick sync — kicking off a pricing page experiment this week. Goal: test simpler tier names + inline FAQ + a micro calculator for monthly est. Staging doc: https://notion.redwood/pricing-experiments.

Priya: Love it. Can we make the calculator default to committed pricing? Most leads ask about committed vs metered.

Riley: UI can do a toggle. I'll mock 2 variants: Compact (single slider) and Detailed (line-item). ETA EOD Tue.

Jordan: For inbound routing, we should flag heavy-estimate results (> $10k/mo) as SAL and route to Sales queue `pricing-high-touch`. How will we surface that? webhook?

Marc: We'll add a hidden GTM event `pricing_calc_estimate` + field `high_touch:true`. Snippet:
```nwindow.dataLayer.push({event:'pricing_calc_estimate', estimate:12000, high_touch:true})
```

Dana: I'll update FAQ copy — adding 3 Qs: "what counts as a token?", "how do reserved commits work?", "can I mix dedicated + hosted?" Draft by Wed.

Alex: Also planning a webinar on Apr 7 for customers comparing Dedicated vs Hosted — we should tie experiment narrative into invites. @Priya can you coordinate invite CTA variants?

Priya: Yep. Two CTAs: "Calculate your cost" (micro-calc route) and "Book a capacity consult" (SAL route). Running 50/50.

Riley: Putting staging build on /pricing?variant=calc_compact and calc_detailed. @deploy-bot can you push the preview link?

deploy-bot: Preview deployed: https://staging.redwood/pricing?variant=calc_compact (expires in 72h).

Jordan: Measurement plan: primary metric = CTA click-through, secondary = request-to-demo conversion. Can we set experiment ids `pricing_v3_a` and `pricing_v3_b`?

Marc: Done. Event names: - `pricing_v3_a_click` - `pricing_v3_b_click`. I'll hook them to Looker and add a dashboard.

Dana: Quick note — add FAQ anchor links for SEO and ensure canonical tag to avoid duplicate content.

Alex: Thanks team. Next check-in Fri 11am. If anyone needs to change routing rules, ping @Jordan and @Marc. :rocket:
